the following aspects: (1) we present a novel method to generate depth images of physically possible object configurations in a physics simulator; (2) we design a multi-task learning architecture to jointly learn 2D detection and 6D pose estimation of multiple instances; (3) we introduce a joint registration network to remove physically implausible 3D pose hypotheses, and (4) we show the effectiveness of our architecture on synthetic and real depth data.
